name: Paan Masala Mouth Freshener – 180gm
original_description:
Paan Masala Mukhwas is a type of after-meal snack or breath freshener made with betel leaf, areca nut, and various spices and flavorings. It is similar to traditional paan, but Mukhwas is made with a blend of finely ground ingredients that are meant to be chewed rather than swallowed whole.

Paan Masala Mukhwas is flavored with a mixture of spices and other ingredients, including cardamom, fennel, aniseed, and rose petals, which give it a distinctive taste and aroma. It is typically consumed as a digestive aid or to freshen the breath after eating. Paan Masala Mukhwas is a popular snack in many parts of the Indian subcontinent and is known for its refreshing and invigorating properties.

Benefits Paan Masala Mouth Freshener:

  • An ideal companion for promoting digestion and revitalizing the breath following a satisfying meal.
  • An exceptional post-meal treat and breath rejuvenator that combines the virtues of betel leaf, areca nut, and an assortment of spices and flavorings.
  • Embraces the essence of traditional paan while presenting itself in finely ground form, designed to be cherished through the act of chewing, not mere ingestion.
  • Elevated by the infusion of a symphony of spices and ingredients, including cardamom, fennel, aniseed, and the graceful presence of rose petals, which collectively shape its distinctive and aromatic flavor profile.
